tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory. Also bidders shall not be blacklisted by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
EMD shall be furnished as prescribed in the tender document. Tender processing fee paid is not refundable by the Department.
Samples shall be submitted as per Section II, Instruction to Tenderers, clause 7.2 of the tender document.
Prices shall be quoted all inclusive at E-portal. Prices quoted in the E-portal will only be Considered for Evaluation.
Please refer Section V and Section VI of the Tender Documents for Details and Specifications.

All terms and conditions are applicable as per the tender document. Also the updates of KTPP and rules made there under as on published date. Any amendments shall only be published in e-procurement portal only.
All documents related to tender shall be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The manufacturer or the trader shall be in the business at least in the past Three years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Documents shall be furnished.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall have average annual turnover of atleast Rs. 64.00 lakhs in each of the previous three years. (In each of the three preceding assessment year 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) Whereas for Micro and Small Enterprises the average annual turnover shall be 50% of the estimated cost for the last two preceding financial years. Which will be verified from the Annual returns of GST submitted as mentioned in clause 7.1 of ITT if required.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Documents shall be furnished.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should furnish the information on all past supplies and satisfactory performance in proforma under Section XI.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Documents shall be furnished.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Acknowledgement of IT returns filed for the previous three years - AY 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26.
BIS details for the participating Item - if applicable.
Copies of Latest GST returns filed.
Copies of Registration Certificate of GST.
Copy of the Acknowledgement for Submitting the Samples shall be uploaded.
Declaration stating that the tenderer has read & understood all the terms and conditions of the tender document.
Declaration stating the rates quoted in the e-portal is inclusive of all - Refer Section VIII Tender Form & Price Schedule Note of the Tender Document.

Declaration that the turnover clause as specified in the qualification criteria is fulfilled - Supporting document like GST returns monthly/Quarterly/Annually or Turnover Certificate issued by Registered CA.
Declaration to the extent of compliance or abide for the tender conditions.
Declarations vide Annexure 1 and 2 regarding bidders of a country sharing land border with India.
Information about the Rates of GST applicable for the participating items - SGST & CGST or IGST whichever is applicable, Percentage of GST applicable shall be mentioned item wise.
Letter of acceptance to hold the rates for the contract period.
Packing details of the tendered products.
The bidder shall duly fill in and submit the Performance Statement in the prescribed format provided under Section XI - Performance Statement of the tender document.
The bidder shall submit the Compliance Statement as per Section XIV of the tender document.
